author: brossow
releaseNotes: Reliability fixes. A failed login now backs off — 2, 4, 8 minutes and so on, up to an hour — instead of retrying on every poll, and a rejected password waits an hour and says to fix it in Preferences, protecting the account the Rheem app also uses. Commands that fail no longer show as done, and an expired session now re-authenticates and resends the command. Thermostat: Med.Lo and Med.Hi fan speeds read correctly instead of as auto; unrecognized status text in off or auto reports idle rather than heating; and in auto mode, a setpoint change that would push the other setpoint past its limit is refused with an explanation. Water heater (not yet tested on hardware): a mode the unit doesn't offer is refused instead of silently ignored, and the last-used mode now survives a hub reboot.
